summary.weighting_definition: Category counts and absolute label gap sums are divided by all eligible comparisons of each group, including ties. Groups with no comparisons contribute zero and remain in their original34/33/33 group denominator. Overall values average the three seed means; reversed_gap_ratio divides weighted gap contributions.
summary.interpretation: The two families describe separate cached-score errors; their gap contributions are not deployment regret.

limitations: These are repeated development analyses on the original100 training groups.
Candidate pairs within a group are dependent; pair counts are not an independent sample size.
Report the two families separately because their action-pair denominators differ; do not interpret their relative magnitudes as an additive causal decomposition of deployment regret.
